description: Source code for the 'gn' command-line tool, specifically handling the 'args' command which manages build arguments, including listing, editing, and displaying argument details in various formats.

methods.name: DoesLineBeginWithComment
methods.description: Checks if a line begins with a comment character '#' after skipping whitespace.

methods.name: BackUpToLineBegin
methods.description: Returns the offset of the beginning of the line given an offset within data.

methods.name: StripHashFromLine
methods.description: Removes the '#' character and normalizes whitespace in a comment line.

methods.name: GetContextForValue
methods.description: Retrieves the file location, line number, and preceding comment for a given value.

methods.name: PrintDefaultValueInfo
methods.description: Prints information about a default value, including its origin and comments.

methods.name: PrintArgHelp
methods.description: Displays help information for a build argument, including current and default values.

methods.name: BuildArgJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON representation of a build argument's details.

methods.name: ListArgs
methods.description: Lists all build arguments in the specified build directory, with options for JSON, short, or override-only formats.

methods.name: RunEditor
methods.description: Opens a file in the user's preferred editor, waiting for editing to complete.

methods.name: EditArgsFile
methods.description: Opens the args file for editing, creating it if necessary, then triggers a build.

methods.name: RunArgs
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'args' command, dispatching to list or edit modes based on arguments.
